output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When a user calls mintToken, the balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount; totalSupply += mintedAmount; Transfer(0, this, mintedAmount); Transfer(this, target, mintedAmount); is executed, if mintedAmount is large enough, the totalSupply value can overflow, causing it to become unusable, and allowing the owner to steal the funds of any user.
